    """P(exposed) per unit for the Hajek estimators: closed form for Bernoulli, Monte Carlo else"""
    deg = gobs.deg

def pooled_slope(deg, p, h):
    """Cov(h(f), f)/Var(f) pooled over units with degrees `deg` (z independent of f)"""
    ds, cnt = np.unique(deg, return_counts=True)
    wts = cnt / cnt.sum()
    cov = var = 0.0
    for d, w in zip(ds, wts):

        pm = binom.pmf(k, d, p)
        f = k / d

    """exact population-OLS bias of chin for a mechanism y = M z (+ noise) under Bernoulli(p), on the realised graph g.
    M sparse/dense n x n; Cov(y,z) = v mean_i M_ii, Cov(y,f) = v mean_i sum_j M_ij W_ij, Var f = v mean_i sum_j W_ij^2"""
    import scipy.sparse as sp

    vf = np.asarray(W.multiply(W).sum(1)).ravel().mean()
